title: backpressure-mollifier-and-quiet-restore-bridge
author: Anika Rao
description: Problem: During sustained cross-region egress saturation we saw a cascade where aggressive egress trimming triggered immediate tenant eviction and a noisy reconnect loop. Root cause traced to two interacting behaviors: (1) the regional backpressure gate aggressively signaled full-shed when internal egress counters hit the threshold without a short stabilization window, and (2) the reconnect path immediately re-queued evicted connections with no pacing, causing repeated rapid state flips and SLO churn. Motivation: introduce a short, well-instrumented mollifier that smooths the backpressure signal and a lightweight 'quiet restore' bridge for evicted tenants that paces reconnection and preserves SLO-critical KV cache where possible. This PR implements a conservative hotfix that reduces SLO violations during regional egress spikes while maintaining correctness.
commits: fix: introduce backpressure_mollifier with exponential smoothing and hysteresis
feat: add quiet_restore_bridge to connection orchestration path
chore: add telemetry events for mollifier state transitions and pacing metrics
test: unit tests for mollifier edge cases and paced reconnect behavior
docs: inline comments and runbook snippet for incident responders
review_comments: Marco Lin: Can you clarify the choice of a 5s stabilization window? Is that empirically derived or conservative?
Anika Rao: 5s chosen after replaying prod traffic in staging; it's conservative and configurable via feature-flag. Added comment and config override.
Sofia Patel: Please ensure mollifier doesn't swallow transient load spikes from legitimate onboarding traffic — add percentile-based gating.
Anika Rao: Added gating to only engage mollifier when 99th egress percentile exceeds threshold for >2s. Unit tests updated.
Derek Huang: LGTm apart from one telemetry label naming nit — prefer 'mollifier_state' over 'mollify_state' for consistency.
Anika Rao: Renamed telemetry label and added a migration note for dashboards.
release_notes: Hotfix: reduce SLO violations during regional egress surges by smoothing backpressure signals and pacing tenant reconnections. Configurable via 'egress.mollifier' feature flag. Add telemetry: mollifier_state, quiet_restore_paced_reconnects.
rollback_plan: Feature flag toggle to disable mollifier and restore previous egress gating immediately; restore_bridge uses in-memory pacing token so disabling stops new paced reconnects within ~2s. Full rollback instructions in docs/runbooks/quiet-restore.md
testing_summary: Replayed two weeks of production traffic in staging with synthetic egress spikes; mollifier reduced eviction churn by ~73% and 95th percentile SLO violations by 41%. Added unit/integration coverage for edge conditions. Observability: new events surfaced to staging dashboards for live verification.
notable_risks: If the smoothing window is set too long it may delay necessary emergency shedding; conservative defaults chosen and exposed via cluster runtime config. Quiet restore holds small reconnect buffer which may slightly increase short-lived memory usage for very large tenant cohorts.
postmerge_actions: 1) Roll forward dashboards with new telemetry panels (ENG-4882). 2) Monitor SLOs and reconnect pacing metrics for 48h. 3) Schedule follow-up to evaluate lowering conservative thresholds (ENG-4827).
notes_for_oncall: If region re-enters sustained egress saturation with mollifier engaged and SLOs still degrade, use feature-flag to disable 'egress.mollifier' and trigger manual egress circuit if needed. See docs/runbooks/quiet-restore.md for commands.
ci_flakiness: There was one e2e-regional-failover flake on first run; test retried and passed. All CI green at merge.
audit_trail: telemetry event names and doc links added; mollifier state transitions are logged to 'egress.mollifier_state' metric and event stream.
